basic_details.job_title: AIU Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Consultant & Young Professional Posts
basic_details.post_name: Consultant, Young Professional (Sports), Young Professional (Finance), Young Professional (IT), Young Professional (AI)

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News

qualification.details: post name: Eligibility | consultant: Retired from Government sector at the level of Joint Secretary/Deputy Secretary/Under Secretary or equivalent, with relevant experience preferably in Internationalization of Higher Education/Higher Education Administration in Government Departments/Autonomous Bodies/Universities. | young professional (sports): Graduate in any discipline with PG Diploma/Certificate (minimum 6 months, full time) in Sports Management or related field OR experience in Management/Tournaments/Championships/Sports at SAI, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports/Sports University, etc. OR Sportsmen/women who played up to State level/AIU All India Championships/Khelo India, etc. | young professional (finance): Post Graduate in Commerce/Finance/Management OR PG Diploma in Accounts/Finance/Management/Business Administration, with minimum 3 years' relevant experience in accounts, TDS/GST/EPF compliance, payroll, reconciliation or audit support in Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous Bodies/PSUs/Educational Institutes. Working knowledge of Tally required; SAP/ERP exposure and PFMS experience desirable. | young professional (it): B.Tech (Computer Science)/B.Sc. Computer Science/BCA with minimum 3 years' experience in ASP.NET with C# (VS 2022) and SQL Server/PHP development (WordPress customization), Server Management, Financial & ERP Systems. | young professional (ai): Postgraduate/technical/professional degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Public Policy, Data Science or related discipline. Knowledge of AI governance, machine learning, data ethics, and emerging technology policy desirable; experience in AI research, technology policy or data analysis preferred.

selection_process: Candidates will be shortlisted based on eligibility criteria and called for a written test/interview at AIU's discretion. Mere fulfillment of eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for test or interview. AIU reserves the right to relax any stipulated conditions and shortlist candidates as it deems appropriate. No TA/DA will be provided to candidates for attending the test or interview.
how_to_apply: Interested and eligible candidates must submit completed applications in the prescribed format, along with the application fee (via Demand Draft in favour of "Association of Indian Universities," payable at New Delhi), in a sealed envelope addressed to the Secretary General, Association of Indian Universities, AIU House, 16, Comrade Indrajit Gupta Marg, New Delhi 110002. The application must be submitted within 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News. The application form and further details are available on the official AIU website: www.aiu.ac.in.
important_instructions: AIU reserves the right not to fill any advertised post(s) without assigning any reason. AIU reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts to be filled, or decide not to fill any post(s), at its discretion. The Association's decision in this regard shall be final.

content_sections.heading: AIU Recruitment 2026: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies: 1 Consultant post and 4 Young Professional posts (2 in Sports, 1 each in Finance, IT, and AI). Note: The cut-off date for determining eligibility and age shall be the closing date for receipt of applications.

rows.eligibility: Retired from Government sector at the level of Joint Secretary/Deputy Secretary/Under Secretary or equivalent, with relevant experience preferably in Internationalization of Higher Education/Higher Education Administration in Government Departments/Autonomous Bodies/Universities.

Graduate in any discipline with PG Diploma/Certificate (minimum 6 months, full time) in Sports Management or related field OR experience in Management/Tournaments/Championships/Sports at SAI, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports/Sports University, etc. OR Sportsmen/women who played up to State level/AIU All India Championships/Khelo India, etc.

Post Graduate in Commerce/Finance/Management OR PG Diploma in Accounts/Finance/Management/Business Administration, with minimum 3 years' relevant experience in accounts, TDS/GST/EPF compliance, payroll, reconciliation or audit support in Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous Bodies/PSUs/Educational Institutes. Working knowledge of Tally required; SAP/ERP exposure and PFMS experience desirable.

B.Tech (Computer Science)/B.Sc. Computer Science/BCA with minimum 3 years' experience in ASP.NET with C# (VS 2022) and SQL Server/PHP development (WordPress customization), Server Management, Financial & ERP Systems.

Postgraduate/technical/professional degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Public Policy, Data Science or related discipline. Knowledge of AI governance, machine learning, data ethics, and emerging technology policy desirable; experience in AI research, technology policy or data analysis preferred.

rows.remuneration: Last Pay Drawn (Basic Pay + DA) minus Basic Pension plus DA thereon, subject to ceiling: Rs. 70,000/- p.m. (Joint Secretary level), Rs. 60,000/- p.m. (Deputy Secretary level), Rs. 50,000/- p.m. (Under Secretary level)

content_sections.heading: AIU Recruitment 2026: Period of Engagement
content_sections.text: Consultant: Initial engagement of six (06) months Young Professionals (all categories): Initial engagement of one (01) year AIU reserves the right to curtail or extend the period of engagement.

content_sections.heading: AIU Recruitment 2026: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on eligibility criteria and called for a written test/interview at AIU's discretion. Mere fulfillment of eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for test or interview. AIU reserves the right to relax any stipulated conditions and shortlist candidates as it deems appropriate. No TA/DA will be provided to candidates for attending the test or interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Points to Note
content_sections.text: AIU reserves the right not to fill any advertised post(s) without assigning any reason. AIU reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts to be filled, or decide not to fill any post(s), at its discretion. The Association's decision in this regard shall be final.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies: 1 Consultant post and 4 Young Professional posts (2 in Sports, 1 each in Finance, IT, and AI).

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for AIU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 65 years for the Consultant post and not exceeding 35 years for all Young Professional posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for AIU Consultant and Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The Consultant post carries remuneration up to Rs. 70,000 per month (based on last rank held), while Young Professional posts carry remuneration between Rs. 30,000 and Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for AIU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline in the prescribed format, in a sealed envelope, sent to the Secretary General, AIU, New Delhi, along with the application fee via Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for AIU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted within 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Young Professional (IT) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.Tech in Computer Science, B.Sc. in Computer Science, or BCA, along with a minimum of 3 years of experience in ASP.NET with C#, SQL Server, PHP/WordPress development, or ERP systems.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for AIU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants must submit the application fee through a Demand Draft in favour of "Association of Indian Universities," payable at New Delhi, along with the application form.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the AIU Recruitment 2026 application form?
faq.answer: The application format and complete details are available on the official AIU website: www.aiu.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of engagement for these posts?
faq.answer: The Consultant post has an initial engagement of six months, while Young Professional posts have an initial engagement of one year, extendable at AIU's discretion.

faq.question: Q10. Will candidates get TA/DA for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, AIU will not provide TA/DA to candidates for attending the test or interview.
